findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preflight, phion_search · Private data: index_feed, try_service, secret_redaction_preflight, oauth_token_audience_guard, resource_cycle_guard, rwa_sanctions_screening_evidence, document_to_verified_json, contact_enrichment_evidence, delegated_credential_guard, x402_v2_router, phion_enrich · Public sink: oauth_token_audience_guard, webhook_verifier · Destructive: phion_preflight, phion_execute, index_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preflight, phion_search · Private data: index_feed, try_service, secret_redaction_preflight, oauth_token_audience_guard, resource_cycle_guard, rwa_sanctions_screening_evidence, document_to_verified_json, contact_enrichment_evidence, delegated_credential_guard, x402_v2_router, phion_enrich · Public sink: oauth_token_audience_guard, webhook_verifier · Destructive: phion_preflight, phion_execute, index_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
